mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) signals weakening economic activity, which typically leads to lower equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth is negative, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 2.0% in a 3-month period, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates for equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets react to the policy shift.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when both PAYEMS growth is negative and UNRATE rises by more than 0.1pp, or the Rank IC over a 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as manufacturing slowdowns signal reduced corporate activity and earnings, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO is declining, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates inflationary pressures that prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations face higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL is rising, or the Rank IC over a 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,000,000 units in a 3-month period, it signals a weakening real estate market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a housing market slowdown due to restrictive monetary policy, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1000.0 and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over a 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as reduced consumer spending and corporate profit margins lead to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
